verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API, and its docs explicitly mention automating flag toggles from a deploy script. A hands-on probe also booted the Docker image and created a user, org, flag and SDK connection entirely through the API, with no UI involved. Coverage is still partial: the evidence shows API-driven automation, but no dedicated CLI, CI integration guide or published OpenAPI spec (the OpenAPI probe paths returned 404). Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-runner integration (e.g. GitHub Action), a published OpenAPI spec, and documented end-to-end CI workflows with independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: GrowthBook offers a full REST API for interacting with the application.
automate it (for example, from a deploy script) with the toggle feature endpoint, which switches a flag on or off in one or more environments.
the first user and organization were created through the API, a boolean feature `pa-probe-flag` was created, an SDK connection was minted
run docker compose up -d to start everything and view the app at http://localhost:3000
